name: Ryu, Dragon's Fist

entries.name: Ryūken Stance
entries.text: As a reaction, mark a creature for 1 minute. The marked target takes a 1d4 AC penalty when targeted by your unarmed attacks (until the end of the turn).

entries.name: Ryū Aura
entries.text: Ryu Hijutsu use Strength instead of Intelligence.

entries.name: Dragon Energy
entries.text: Once per turn, your Taijutsu and Bukijutsu damage ignores temporary hit points.

entries.name: Dragon's Assault
entries.text: Spend a bonus action to make 2 additional unarmed/weapon attacks. These attacks cannot be made at disadvantage.

entries.name: Dragon's Dance
entries.text: When using a Ryu Hijutsu, gain +5 ft. speed and +2 damage to Ryu Hijutsu/unarmed attacks. Applies up to 2 times per turn, max +25 ft./+10 damage.

entries.name: Ryū Form
entries.text: Spend an Elite Action and 1 Tenacity die to increase your Draconic Stage by 1: • Stage 1: +1 AC, +1 unarmed damage die. • Stage 2: Ryu Hijutsu damage increases by your current Stage. • Stage 3: Unarmed attacks gain Reach 2; Ryu Hijutsu can't be dispelled by equal/lower rank jutsu. • Stage 4: +1 AC, +1 unarmed damage die. • Stage 5: Cannot lose concentration on Ryu Hijutsu.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: Make 3 attacks or 1 Dragon Tail attack.

entries.name: Punch
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (3d6 + 3) elemental damage.

entries.name: Kick
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (5d6 + 3) elemental damage.

entries.name: Dragon Tail
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (8d6 + 8) elemental damage. The target must make a Strength save (DC 18) or be knocked prone. Recharge 5-6.

entries.name: Elite Action
entries.text: Can take one Elite Action at the end of another creature's turn to move, attack, cast a jutsu, or gain an extra reaction. Regains it at the start of its turn.

notes: The metadata line names no affiliation. Both B-Rank jutsu lines print "(Cost: 15)"; transcribed as the standard B-Rank cost of 14. The printed average damage figures for Punch, Kick and Dragon Tail do not match their dice; kept as printed.
